chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from al-Nawfali, from al-'Ayashi, from 'Isa ibn 'Abdullah al-Hashimi, from his father, from his grandfather, who said:

Ali (peace be upon him) said: There is no objection to marrying her during her postpartum bleeding period, but he should not have sexual intercourse with her until she is purified from the postpartum blood.

key_terms.يُجَامِعَهَا: to have sexual intercourse with her

ai.seo_question: Can a woman be married while she is still in her postpartum bleeding period?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam Ali (AS), the distinction is drawn between the validity of the marriage contract (nikah) and the permissibility of sexual intercourse (jima') during the postpartum period (nifas). This ruling highlights a key principle in Shia jurisprudence where the marital bond is established immediately, while consummation is deferred until the completion of ritual purification (ghusl), ensuring both legal continuity and ritual purity.
